chunks: And if it were not that all people would become one community (of unbelievers), We might have given those who disbelieve in Ar-Rahman roofs of silver for their dwellings and (silver) stairs for mounting,
ai.seo_question: Why did God not give all disbelievers immense wealth and grandeur?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine wisdom of limiting material allurements to prevent humanity from becoming a monolithic community of disbelievers, thereby preserving the test of faith. The imagery of silver roofs and staircases symbolizes the seductive power of worldly wealth, which, if universally granted to disbelievers, would obliterate the distinction between belief and disbelief. This underscores the concept of *fitnah* (trial) as a necessary condition for spiritual growth and the eventual selection of the righteous.
